note: Wooded hills and natural areas south of Bloomfield. The one primitive camping area is at gravel parking lot C on County Road 517, with a privy and a pavilion; horse trailer parking is separate. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Individual Campsites' (+ walk-in), Rule 140 standard; map (04/19) one 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol at lot C with privy + pavilion; brochure 'Camping is permitted only in locations designated on the area map'. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual + 2027 permit; privy added. Pin is in woods 50 m N of lot C - move onto the lot. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Open Camping - Walk-in/Float-in/Backpack; Individual Campsites'; Rule 140 standard text, no permit rule. Brochure: 'Camping is permitted only in locations designated on the area map.' Map (04/19): one 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol beside 'Parking Lot (C - H)' C, with privy, pavilion and an accessible symbol, off C.R. 517 (GIS 27 point 359; GIS 26 lot 570, 56 m). Imagery: lot C is an open gravel lot ~40 x 35 m - a 23-ft rig fits. Designated point at a lot - stays.

HORSE: the area has horseback trails and 'Horse Trailer Parking (A - B)'; lot B is across C.R. 517 from the camping area. The camping symbol is at lot C, not at a horse lot, and nothing calls it an equestrian camp - kept.
PIN: stored 36.85131,-89.92198 = GIS 359, in woods ~50 m north of lot C (no pad visible there in leaf-off imagery). Move to lot 570: 36.85087,-89.92231.
CLUSTERS: one camping area; near.py nothing else within 3 km.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): only small fishing lakes 1 and 2 (a few acres) ~300 m+ east; none at the camp.

FEES FROM MARCH 2027 (applies to every MDC area entry and the state:missouri-conservation-areas policy row): MDC release https://mdc.mo.gov/node/307038 ('Campers will need permits to camp on MDC areas starting in March'): 'The Missouri Conservation Commission gave final approval at its Oct. 23 open meeting ... to regulation changes ... that would require campers to purchase a permit to camp on MDC areas starting in March 2027'; 'purchase a permit for $5 for up to five days of camping on conservation areas for up to 10 people'; 'Each person will be limited to three consecutive camping permits and six camping permits annually'; 'available for purchase beginning in March online, at a permit vendor, or over the phone'. The camping page still says 'All camping on conservation areas is free' (true until then), so nightly_low/high 0 written as today's value with the 2027 permit in fees.note; the policy row's fees and booking note need the same update.
